rows.title: Risk Case is not ISO Risk
rows.retained_claim: Separate case, entry and revision keys; labels do not merge identities.
rows.limit: Actual organizational case grounding and real reassessment continuity require attributable evidence; no automatic identity adjudication.

rows.title: No realization from description
rows.retained_claim: Documentary scenarios/source statements do not automatically assert actual occurrence or effect.
rows.limit: No claim that every external inference/application obeys the boundary or that a missing graph assertion proves nonoccurrence.

rows.title: Issued version immutability
rows.retained_claim: Executed SQLite profile 0.1.0 preserves sealed payload, provenance and version-owned dependency snapshots, creates new revisions and rejects specified mutations.
rows.limit: No general native InformationContent/RX-007 admission, PostgreSQL/full private-schema migration or protection against administrative DDL/PRAGMA bypass.

rows.title: Assessment interpretation
rows.retained_claim: Selected comparison records require pinned interpretation metadata and matching declared context; equal score labels/numbers cannot authorize that named task.
rows.limit: Not universal assessment readiness, full temporal semantics, all qualitative likelihood interpretations or reproduced version-specific method payload permissions.

rows.title: Temporal and administrative distinction
rows.retained_claim: Recorded/reference/validity time and administrative versus real-world status remain distinct design commitments; synthetic retrieval illustrates closure versus cessation.
rows.limit: Interval ordering, timezone/unknown-endpoint policy, actual cessation and treatment-effectiveness adjudication or workflow execution are not implemented/accepted claims.

rows.title: Relator participant distinctness
rows.retained_claim: Bounded OWL and explicit-data tests enforce declared participant distinctness and retain assignment information when no relator can be grounded.
rows.limit: Explicit identity evidence is required; different names alone do not prove different individuals or actual mandate truth.

rows.title: Role-qualified ownership
rows.retained_claim: A responsibility role/assignment record is not automatically an actual mandate or Risk Owner.
rows.limit: Automatic source-to-owner mapping with validated accountability/authority/scope is deferred; no automatic Risk Owner population.

rows.title: Description aboutness
rows.retained_claim: Published-description SHACL checks explicit case/pattern/scenario aboutness and permits multiple declared targets.
rows.limit: Not HermiT discharge, target truth, occurrence evidence or a single universal target interpretation.

rows.title: Framework-qualified tolerance
rows.retained_claim: Distinct source-qualified tolerance meanings are represented without global equivalence.
rows.limit: Complete normative appetite/tolerance definitions and ISO/COBIT/Risk IT equivalence/crosswalk/compliance are unassessed and unclaimed.

rows.title: Vocabulary resource identity
rows.retained_claim: Vocabulary metadata is keyed by scheme/edition/code; label equality does not create classes or cross-scheme identity.
rows.limit: Metadata key validation is not universal ontological identity adjudication or a HermiT PASS for this clause.

rows.title: Evidence does not endorse
rows.retained_claim: Selected evidence records carry source/item/target and Support/Challenge/Context role; source-query provenance can be inspected.
rows.limit: Conformance and source links do not establish truth, endorsement, evidential adequacy or independent corroboration.

rows.title: Scale and dimension compatibility
rows.retained_claim: Profile 0.7.0 checks selected level/scale-version/dimension joins for the declared comparison task.
rows.limit: No general level ordering, numeric-code ranking, unit transformation or proof of scale meaning.

rows.title: Heterogeneous boundaries
rows.retained_claim: Three optional heterogeneous boundaries and seven bridges are excluded from the typed core; documentary reference classes remain.
rows.limit: Structural/boundary checks are not new HermiT runs or proof of external referent existence; external ontology import/mapping extension stays future work.

rows.title: Intrinsic vulnerability bearer
rows.retained_claim: Bounded OWL bearer dependence/cardinality supports the intrinsic-vulnerability design; reports remain documentary information.
rows.limit: Full explicit-data bearer admission and real-world substantial-bearer/vulnerability grounding remain unexecuted/unaccepted; no automatic mode from a hypothesis.

rows.title: Admission profiles
rows.retained_claim: CatalogInspection metadata admission and separately named compatibility/comparison/source/history tasks have explicit staging and task boundaries.
rows.limit: No general complete RiskAssessment readiness or arbitrary multi-relation/conditional integration; only named executed profiles may be called supported.

rows.title: Multiple assertions
rows.retained_claim: Selected source-query/SQL fixtures retain conflicting assertions, original/reissued values and provenance without silently selecting or overwriting.
rows.limit: A universal scalar-export selection policy across all contexts/times and complete multi-assertion admission is deferred.

rows.title: Comparable assessments
rows.retained_claim: Profile 0.7.0 checks strict eligibility for direct comparison of two selected pairs under declared pinned interpretation; missing data is not zero.
rows.limit: Governed transformations, ranking/calculation, general temporal interpretation and universal assessment comparability are not claimed.

rows.title: Workflow semantics
rows.retained_claim: Workflow labels/rules/authority remain source-qualified design content; Closed/Treated alone cannot establish cessation/effectiveness.
rows.limit: No executable transition authority engine, universal workflow scheme mapping or treatment-effectiveness acceptance is claimed.

rows.title: Risk Item vocabulary
rows.retained_claim: Risk Item is a local terminology convention for the managed RiskCase subject, distinct from entry/scenario/ISO risk.
rows.limit: No global Risk Item equivalence, automatic label-based import/class alignment or universal terminology standard.

rows.title: Reported and computed scores
rows.retained_claim: Reported and computed score meanings/links are distinguished in the conceptual design.
rows.limit: Complete current conditional computed-score admission, formula/input scalar schema and reproducible arithmetic engine are not executed public capabilities. Historical private calculation checks remain historical.

rows.title: Responsibility identity

rows.limit: Actual assignment/scope/validity grounding and application deduplication of mandates are deferred; no new actual responsibility identities from names.

rows.title: Context relation coherence
